# assets/vendor

Source packs the art pipeline reads. Everything here is CC0 1.0 (public domain) or
SIL OFL, so the placeholder art can ship and be replaced without licensing work.

These are placeholders. When the group delivers hand-drawn sprites, replace the files
under `assets/game/` (see `assets/README.md` for the file map) and leave this folder
alone.

| Folder | Pack | License | Source | Feeds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kenney/roguelike` | Roguelike/RPG pack, 16x16 | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-rpg-pack | Ground, dirt, bush, stone, furniture, riddle and gate tiles |
| `kenney/urban_tilemap` | RPG Urban Pack, 16x16 | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-urban-pack | Castle gate and street tiles (candidates) |
| `kenney/tds_characters` | Top-down Shooter characters | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/top-down-shooter | Guard, citizen and attendant bodies (candidates) |
| `kenney/platformer-characters` | Platformer Characters | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/platformer-characters | Every walk cycle: River, Jin, Kandy, Matt, Nadia, guards, Aquarius cast, grandparent |
| `kenney/fish-pack` | Fish Pack | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/fish-pack | Aquarius fish, seaweed, foreground reef |
| `kenney/space-kit` | Space Kit | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/space-kit | Cosma boulders, crystals, meteor, pebbles |
| `kenney/planets` | Planets | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/planets | Cosma background planets |
| `kenney/particle-pack` | Particle Pack | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack | Dust, bubbles, sparks, stars, magic, flame, light pools |
| `kenney/interface-sounds` | Interface Sounds | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds | Confirm, error, click, back, select, question |
| `kenney/impact-sounds` | Impact Sounds | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds | Footsteps (grass, sand, stone, wood, snow), splash |
| `kenney/rpg-audio` | RPG Audio | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio | Page turn, coin |
| `oga/castle-tileset.png` | 2D Castle Platformer Tileset 16x16 | CC0 | https://opengameart.org/content/2d-castle-platformer-tileset-16x16 | Cosma walkway masonry |
| `oga/neonode.png` | Neon Node | CC0 | https://opengameart.org/content/neon-node | Cosma neon circuit trim |
| `itch/README.txt` | Retro Lines tileset | CC0 | https://v3x3d.itch.io/retro-lines | Drop-in slot, not used yet |
| `../fonts/*.ttf` | Press Start 2P, VT323 | SIL OFL 1.1 | Google Fonts | UI and dialogue text |

License texts ship beside the packs (`*_LICENSE.txt`, `oga/LICENSE.txt`, `fonts/*OFL.txt`).
